page.overview:
Who is Aite?

Aite, known as Nagare Kandagawa in the Japanese version, is a character in the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force series. He is a Slifer Red student.

The player is able to give Aite sandwiches. The following tables detail how much he likes or dislikes the sandwiches.
